reason: The README clearly describes a DSH plugin whose primary purpose is rendering interactive visual and structured UI surfaces inside assistant replies, including dashboards, charts, plots, forms, quizzes, media, and persistent panels.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 助手回复中渲染可交互的仪表盘、图表、表单、测验、媒体和持久化面板。
summaries.en: Renders interactive dashboards, charts, forms, quizzes, media, and persistent panels inside DSH assistant replies.

capabilities: Renders declarative interactive UI components inside assistant replies
Displays charts, plots, tables, dashboards, and Mermaid diagrams
Provides forms, quizzes, and locally handled UI interactions
Embeds browser-reachable audio and video media
Maintains a persistent resizable session panel
Sends configured interaction events back to the model
Persists selected UI state per session and content fingerprint
